origins.section: With a Loose M the LP Hires a Sliver of a Contractor
A Loose M Weakens the LP Bound; the MILP Optimum Does Not Move
A Huge M Lets the Integrality Tolerance Switch a Rule Off

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-lp-fee: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-fee: $`h_{g,y} \ge \frac{v}{M_{g,y}}`$, so the LP pays a fee of $`F\,h_{g,y} = \frac{F}{M_{g,y}}\; v`$
recorded.prompt:q-what-changes: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-what-changes: The MILP optimum is the same, $23,341k, for every valid $`M`$ ... A valid $`M`$ never changes which plans are allowed ... Each tighter $`M`$ lowers the bound.
recorded.prompt:q-room: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-room: A switch of $`3 \times 10^{-7}`$ counts as "no contractor", yet gives the row $`3 \times 10^{-7} \cdot M`$ of extra room

recorded.prompt:q-lp-fee:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-lp-fee:a: "In the LP relaxation it may be any number in between, and the LP picks the smallest one the crew row allows."
recorded.prompt:q-lp-fee:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.prompt:q-lp-fee:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.prompt:q-what-changes:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-what-changes:a: "A valid $`M`$ never changes which plans are allowed, so it cannot change the best one."
recorded.prompt:q-what-changes:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-what-changes:c: "Each tighter $`M`$ lowers the bound." In a maximization a looser one raises it: 26,587.4 with 1e6 against 26,334.5.
recorded.prompt:q-what-changes:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-what-changes:d: The LP bounds in the table differ by M choice. "on this model presolve undid most of the damage ... You cannot plan on that".
recorded.prompt:q-room:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:b: "With $`M = 10^7`$ HiGHS reports OPTIMAL ... it hires no contractor and still runs four program-years over their crews"
recorded.prompt:q-room:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:c: The room is the switch's value times M ("$`\epsilon M`$"): 4e-7 x 5e7 = 20, not 50.
recorded.prompt:q-room:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-room:d: "A tolerance that is harmless on numbers near 1 becomes a whole crew-month when it is multiplied by $`10^9`$."
